description: List live deals currently published on StackTheDeal (stackthedeal.com). Deals are verified on the retailer's own page before posting. Returns the newest deals first, with price, regular price, discount percentage, store, and a link to each deal's page on stackthedeal.com (results link to our pages only — the retailer's link lives on that page).

category.description: Category filter, e.g. amazon, electronics, home, baby-kids, travel, bonus.

hot_only.description: Only deals StackTheDeal flagged as hot.

min_discount_pct.description: Only deals at least this percent off (0-100).

store.description: Store filter, exact name, e.g. Amazon, Walmart, Costco.

name: list_deals
title: List live deals
